posts.cooked:
So I've been thinking, and hoping, that it would be really cool to see bios, even small ones, for all the mini-nemesis'. Some of them simply because their story has to be good (Tantrum has to have a great story in my opinion) but also they are connected to the wider story, and just about everything with a nemesis icon has a story behind it to help explain why.

 

Why is Equity (supposedly) after Naturalist? What is Empyreon? How the heck did we get Doc Tusser? How did Vyktor get a Frankenstein lab?

 

My hope is that >G is already planning to release bio's for these guys, I figure Christopher has them locked away either in his folder or his head, but if not my vote is in the yes please corner.

What is Empyreon?

How the heck did we get Doc Tusser?

How did Vyktor get a Frankenstein lab?

(Note these are my opinion of how I see it)

Equity is probably a figure from Naturalists past when he was a dirty business guy himself. Maybe they have a checkered business past together and Naturalist, once he found his inner good guy, maybe screwed Equity over.

Empyreon looks like a water spirit. Interesting tidbit, empyreus is a latin term which relates to being in or around fire (pyr). Empyrean is a word that means composed of pure fire or light and also references a high order of the heavens and the sublime. What does all that mean together? No idea. Interesting name for a water spirit though.

Doc Tusser I'd like to know more about. He doesn't look very human. Wonder what his story is. 

Vyktor, after Voss was banished to the Realm of Discord, probably needed a new home to practice his Mengele impersonations. Baron most certainly would have been happy to help.

posts.name: Ironic
posts.cooked:
Yeah, it's looked silver, beige, and green in assorted art.

I do find it surprising they didn't sneak in a motive rant or something from him somewhere - he is, they say, the first original supervillain Christopher came up with ever, so you'd think they would have been eager to do so.  But, then again, I can respect them for prioritizing the villains they thought could really use the spotlight (the V5).

Of course, to me, the deal with Revenant is relevnt (say that five times fast) to a lesser degree, since in our SotM game banter, we've been alluding to a past supervillain by that codename, now dead, so we'd always assume the new guy was tied in with that, regardless of what we hear.

You know who I am increasingly curious about, though?  Ruin.  Specifically, how the devil did he get to Earth from his usual residence in Snake Mountain, on Planet Eternia, forever plotting to reclaim Castle Greyskull?
